name: The Ritz-Carlton, Beijing
positioning: Business-district Ritz-Carlton in China Central Place with English country manor-style rooms, a Club Lounge and a health club with indoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a central business district base next to shopping and the subway
Families who like the Ritz Kids programme

facts.text: The hotel is in China Central Place, in the heart of Beijing's central business district.
The address is 83A Jian Guo Road, China Central Place, Chaoyang District, Beijing.
The hotel was designed by HBA design consultants.
The hotel is next to the SKP Shopping Centre.
The hotel is steps from the east Third Ring Road and the subway.
The rooms follow an English country manor theme.
Guest rooms have workspaces and marble bathrooms with soaking tubs, and suites have living rooms and walk-in closets.
Each bathroom has an oversize deep soaking tub with an inset TV.
Aroma is the all-day dining restaurant, on the ground floor, specialising in international buffet and cuisine.
The health club has a heated indoor lap pool, steam and dry saunas, beauty treatments and a gymnasium.

highlights.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is on the 16th floor, with views of the city center.
In the Ritz Kids programme, children can set up a camping tent inside their room.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite overlooks the China Central Place gardens from the 15th floor, and a personal butler is available on request.
The Lobby Lounge is styled as an English manor house and serves the Ritz-Carlton traditional afternoon tea.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Access to the Club Lounge requires an upgraded Club booking.
Breakfast at Aroma is available for a fee.
